meta.name: golden-chat-single
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat_single golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证黄金构建的聊天功能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden chat build

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可以读取 golden-chat-single 的 Slack 聊天记录,从中查找解决方案、代码片段、团队决策和故障排除步骤,并据此回答你的问题。
howto.when: 当你要测试 golden_chat_single golden build,或需要从该聊天记录中找解决方案、代码片段、团队决策等信息时触发。

say.text: 在 golden_chat_single 聊天记录里,大家讨论了什么?
say.note: Claude 会读取该聊天记录并概括内容。

say.text: 从 golden_chat_single 历史中找出解决方案。
say.note: Claude 会检索相关讨论并回答。

say.text: 查一下 golden_chat_single 聊天中分享的链接。
say.note: Claude 会查找聊天中分享的链接和资源。

howto.what_en: Claude can read the golden-chat-single Slack chat history and use it to answer questions about solutions, code snippets, team decisions, and troubleshooting steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you test the golden_chat_single golden build, or when you need to find solutions, code snippets, or team decisions from that chat history.

say_en.text: What was discussed in the golden_chat_single chat history?
say_en.note: Claude reads the chat and summarizes.

say_en.text: Find a solution from the golden_chat_single history.
say_en.note: Claude searches the discussion and answers.

say_en.text: Look up links shared in the golden_chat_single chat.
